# Recovery record protocol cases: accept|refuse<TAB>record (\t and \n are escapes). The private source never joins a full upgrade, so a record naming it is never part of the protocol.
accept	reviewed-full-upgrade-commit-pending\n
accept	reviewed-full-upgrade-commit-pending\tblackarch-staged\n
refuse	reviewed-full-upgrade-commit-pending\toniomarchy-private\t3a3f0d6b7c2e1f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2\n
